design: fixed-frame one-per-lineage purposive balanced feasibility sample with deterministic filename ranking; NOT representative random claims
rules: Source docs were selected BEFORE semantic claim reading, using deterministic FNV-1a method.
Candidate paraphrases are not author verbatim and must be confirmed against pinned source. One may be ineligible and is not replaced.
Study observer, original author, source reviewer and blind adjudicator are separate roles. Descriptive statuses never substitute for correctness.
No denominator for error rate, no pseudo-independent treatment observations, no randomized experiment.
